conversation_pain_points: bot ignored request for plain language
bot used medical jargon after correction

main_topics.reason: The opening question and the repeated ask whether she will feel like this forever drive the conversation.
She asked for simpler wording repeatedly (t3, t5, t11, t19) and ended confused.
She describes pain all over, worst in the mornings in hands, shoulders and hips (t1, t9).
She asked in t9 whether tiredness after 9 hours of sleep is part of the condition.
The bot kept listing medicines and she asked how to get them (t13), but she did not engage with the details.
She asked once whether graded exercise means walking (t7).
She said the doctor named the diagnosis and sent her home with no options (t1, t13).
She asked how to obtain the medicines and said she cannot pronounce the names to tell the doctor (t13, t15).
She said her head was spinning and she was more confused than when she started (t11, t17).

output.summary: A 71-year-old with fibromyalgia asked whether anything can be done, since her doctor offered nothing. She repeatedly asked for plain language but the bot kept using terms like SNRI, anticonvulsant and sensitization. She ended the chat tired and confused, with only the advice to ask her doctor about medication and a specialist referral.
